full_judgment: 2. The writ petition in question was filed by respondent Nos.1-105 challenging the order dated 07.01.2009 passed by the Member ভুমি আপীল বোর্ড 4 in Appeal Case Nos.5-139 of 2008 (Jessore). The Member ভূমি আপীল বোর্ড by the said order rejected the appeal affirming those passed by the Additional Divisional Commissioner, Khulna who affirmed the order of the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Jessore (Revenue) dated 19.03.2008 in Miscellaneous Case No.12/XXIII of 2004-2005 declaring the land in question as Baor and that the same was made khas under Section 92 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950.
